newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end lower after overdue rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end lower after overdue rate cut.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates dropped 50 basis points on Monday, matching Friday's overdue repo rate cut, traders said.
Overnight rates finished at 20.125 percent, down from Friday's close of 20.50/625 percent after the central bank (NBH) cut four of its five repo rates by 0.5 percentage point each on Friday.
"The market expected the rate cut somewhat earlier but the NBH probably delayed the move due the troubled Czech crown, in order not to send the wrong signals." said Laszlo Egyed of West-LB Hungaria.
"The cut came a little later but it was also higher than (the usual) 0.25 percent".

The benchmark one-week reverse repo rate was cut to 20.25 percent from 20.75 percent and traders expected overnight rates to hover around or slightly below the new benchmark level for the next few days.
